classification_rulebrains: primary = files under extracted_data/schemas/notes/out/artifacts or NFL-domain endpoints; wildcard = root scripts, docs, incidental and non-NFL material

verification.method: extracted archive to scratch, sha256 compared per file against on-disk originals
verification.note: archive self-inclusion (tar.gz inside itself) excluded from comparison as it is a truncated prefix

nfl-farm/extracted_data/kaggle/hl/2023 H.location_in_archive: nfl-farm/extracted_data/kaggle/hl/2023 HELMET LABORATORY TESTING PERFORMANCE RESULTS - Helmet Innovation.csv

archive_split.reassembly: cat AGENT_HANDOFF_UNIVERSAL.tar.gz.part* > AGENT_HANDOFF_UNIVERSAL.tar.gz && sha256sum -c <<< "$(cat ARCHIVE_SHA256)"  && tar -xzf AGENT_HANDOFF_UNIVERSAL.tar.gz

archive_sha256_note: archive_sha256 is the hash of the whole tar.gz; verify after reassembly

post_archive_audit.method: fresh recursive walk of both trees vs manifest file_manifest
